from __future__ import annotations

"""orchestrator.enrich_findings — see package docstring."""
from vvaharness.report import appcontext
from vvaharness.report.cvss import rating as _cvss_rating
from vvaharness.report.cvss import score_or_sentinel as _cvss_score
from vvaharness.rules.cwe import norm_cwe


def _prefix_path(path: str | None, prefix: str) -> str | None:
    if not path or path.startswith(f"{prefix}/"):
        return path
    return f"{prefix}/{path}"


def _prefix_ref(ref: str | None, prefix: str) -> str | None:
    # source_ref / sink_ref are "file:line" — prefix only the file part.
    if not ref:
        return ref
    file_part, sep, line_part = ref.partition(":")
    return f"{_prefix_path(file_part, prefix)}{sep}{line_part}"


def _enrich_findings(findings: list, app_info,
                     path_prefix: str | None = None) -> None:
    """Post-s7: attach VulContextSeverity env score + OffensivePriority to each verified Finding so s8 can rende..."""
    for f in findings:
        if path_prefix:
            f.file = _prefix_path(f.file, path_prefix)
            f.source_ref = _prefix_ref(getattr(f, "source_ref", None),
                                       path_prefix)
            f.sink_ref = _prefix_ref(getattr(f, "sink_ref", None),
                                     path_prefix)
            for d in f.duplicates:
                d.file = _prefix_path(d.file, path_prefix) or d.file
                d.source_ref = _prefix_ref(d.source_ref, path_prefix)
                d.sink_ref = _prefix_ref(d.sink_ref, path_prefix)
        # DTO carries canonical CWE + vector-derived CVSS so no consumer re-derives; vector wins
        f.cwe = norm_cwe(f.cwe)
        if f.cvss_vector:
            _score = _cvss_score(f.cvss_vector)
            if _score >= 0:
                f.cvss_score = _score
                f.cvss_rating = _cvss_rating(_score)
        if f.cvss_vector and app_info is not None:
            vr = appcontext.vsvs_score(f.cvss_vector, app_info)
            if vr:
                f.vsvs_vector = vr.vector
                f.vsvs_score = vr.score
                f.vsvs_rating = vr.rating
        f.offensive_priority, f.offensive_reason = appcontext.offensive_priority_for(
            f.title, f.vuln_class.value, f.description, f.cvss_vector, app_info)
